blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many people, discovering everything Tanzania offers is a long-held dream. Whether it is an epic Tanzania safari in search of Africa’s Big Five, a climb of Kilimanjaro or lazy days on Zanzibar’s paradise beaches, Tanzania covers it all. The good news: Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that meets all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: For ideas, take a look at our most popular itineraries. Many of our clients like to round off an exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s most beautiful beaches. Does that appeal to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: You can pick one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or have your journey tailored to you; either way, we are happy to help. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just as you want it!

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: When you step out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your own Your Tanzania Trip guide is there with a broad smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' You are driven directly to your hotel, where you can unwind and soak up the African atmosphere. On the following day your guide sets off with you on an exclusive private safari, so you can travel at whatever pace suits you. You have the luxury of your own safari jeep and are free to stop and watch the animals for as long as you wish!

blocks.orig: The village of Mto wa Mbu is a green oasis in between dry savannah plains, close to Lake Manyara National Park. A tuktuk can take a maximum of 3 people and a tour by tuktuk allows for maximum flexibility. Tuktuks can pass through small streets and can stop anywhere you like. The tour leads past the village itself, then into the forest and past several farms and plantations. In one or two hours you will stop at a brewery, a local artist and a local school.
blocks.html: Close to Lake Manyara National Park, the village of Mto wa Mbu forms a green oasis among the dry savannah plains. Each tuktuk holds no more than 3 people, and touring by tuktuk gives you as much flexibility as possible: they fit through narrow streets and can pull over wherever you want. The route takes you past the village, into the forest and along several farms and plantations. Within one or two hours you stop at a brewery, a local artist and a local school.

blocks.orig: Discover the Tanzanian way of cooking, smack in the middle of a banana farm. Pick three local dishes and see and learn how they are prepared. Learn to cook pilau (spiced rice), makande (corn and brown beans in a lovely mix) or ndizi nyama (plaintains with meat), and get a taste of Tanzania!
blocks.html: Get to know Tanzanian cooking right in the heart of a banana farm. Choose three local dishes and watch and learn how they are made. You can learn to prepare pilau (spiced rice), makande (a tasty mix of corn and brown beans) or ndizi nyama (plaintains with meat), and get a real taste of Tanzania!

blocks.orig: Lake Manyara National Park is an ideal place for a scenic safari, with landscapes such as acacia woodlands, jungle forests, mountain cliffs, and grassy areas. Its biodiversity makes it home to the amazing tree-climbing lions, but also to a variety of other animal species such as baboons, elephants, buffalos, warthogs, giraffes, wildebeest, zebras, and many more.
blocks.html: With scenery ranging from acacia woodlands and jungle forests to mountain cliffs and grassland, Lake Manyara National Park is perfect for a scenic safari. Thanks to its biodiversity, it is home to the remarkable tree-climbing lions as well as many other species, including baboons, elephants, buffalos, warthogs, giraffes, wildebeest, zebras and plenty more.

blocks.orig: Gibb's Farm offers the old-age rhythm of an African farm and coffee plantation, right on the slopes of Ngorongoro Highlands. Walk around on this sanctuary of peace and tranquility, and watch vegetables being harvested, coffee roasted, cows milked, and pigs fed. The vegetable gardens, fruit trees, and herbs provide inspiration for the farm's chefs, who in their turn amaze visitors with a delicious lunch. A little piece of heaven!
blocks.html: On the slopes of the Ngorongoro Highlands, Gibb's Farm keeps the age-old rhythm of an African farm and coffee plantation alive. Stroll around this peaceful, tranquil sanctuary and see vegetables being picked, coffee being roasted, cows being milked and pigs being fed. The farm's chefs draw inspiration from the vegetable gardens, fruit trees and herbs, and in turn they delight visitors with a delicious lunch. A small slice of paradise!

blocks.orig: Today you descend into the wonderous caldera of the famous Ngorongoro Crater. This is THE day to start your game drive early when animals are plenty and tourists few! Feel the little hairs on your arms rise as you descend into the crater, awed by the sight of clouds hovering and the numerous animals in sight. Coyotes, hyenas, buffaloes, wildebeests, gazelles, and many more animals can be found here and you are almost guaranteed to see them all.
blocks.html: Today you head down into the wonderful caldera of the well-known Ngorongoro Crater. On this day above all, an early start to your game drive pays off, while there are lots of animals and few tourists! As you drive down into the crater you will feel the hairs on your arms stand up, amazed by the clouds hanging overhead and the many animals around you. Coyotes, hyenas, buffaloes, wildebeests, gazelles and many other animals live here, and you are almost certain to see all of them.

blocks.orig: Fly into the mind-blowing beautiful Serengeti National Park for the epitome of safari. See the infamous Big Five in all their glory, and, in certain months, wildebeests running by the thousands in the Great Migration. And even without that; this is big-cat-paradise with prides of lions on kopjes, cheetahs in the long, yellow grass, and leopards in trees. You arrive in time for an amazing afternoon game drive into the sunset.
blocks.html: Take a flight into the stunningly beautiful Serengeti National Park for safari at its very essence. Watch the famous Big Five in full splendour and, in certain months, thousands of wildebeests racing past during the Great Migration. Even without the migration, this is a paradise for big cats, with prides of lions on kopjes, cheetahs in the tall yellow grass and leopards up in the trees. You get there in time for a wonderful afternoon game drive into the sunset.

blocks.orig: Anything you can think of when you picture a luxurious safari, you will surely find in Serengeti National Park. Not only the Big Five, the famous Great Migration, and a multitude of big cats, but also rarer species such as the gerenuk or the wild dog, and did we mention the plus 500 species of birds? In between, you naturally spot antelopes, giraffes, elephants, zebras, hippos, and many more animals. Make sure to wake up at sunrise for an epic balloon safari...!
blocks.html: Whatever you imagine when you think of a luxurious safari, Serengeti National Park is sure to have it. Besides the Big Five, the well-known Great Migration and an abundance of big cats, you can find rarer animals such as the gerenuk or the wild dog, and did we mention more than 500 bird species? Along the way you will of course see antelopes, giraffes, elephants, zebras, hippos and many other animals. Be sure to get up at sunrise for an epic balloon safari...!

blocks.orig: A balloon safari in the iconic Serengeti National Park will make your Tanzania safari a memorable experience. You rise at sunrise and gently fly over the endless plains of the Serengeti. The hot air balloon floats at treetop height above the baobabs and acacias so that you can see the animals nearby. Watching the wildlife below from your balloon is a fascinating and peaceful experience that comes with breathtaking panoramic views.
blocks.html: Floating over the iconic Serengeti National Park in a balloon turns your Tanzania safari into an experience to remember. You take off at sunrise and drift gently above the endless Serengeti plains. The hot air balloon glides at treetop level over the baobabs and acacias, so you can see the animals up close. Observing the wildlife beneath you from the balloon is a fascinating, peaceful experience, with breathtaking panoramic views thrown in.

blocks.orig: After an amazing safari adventure, you take a plane back to Arusha, after which you are transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your international flight home.
blocks.html: At the end of a wonderful safari adventure you fly back to Arusha, and from there you are transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your international flight home.
